runtime: One HTTP process, eight hotspot workers. No CPU or memory quota. Isolated container on current production host.
network: Docker network none; loopback requests only; external Python connections audited and denied.
scale_boundary: manual3 triples only AI jobs and their source mappings; the catalyst news cache is unchanged.
measurement: Individual latency ends at complete body receipt. Successful throughput includes parsing/hash/client work. Percentiles exclude rejected or failed requests.

tests.final_complete_suite: See the final pull-request commit CI checks; the local full run preceded the final one-slot parameter convergence.
